summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Ghaziabad Times Hindi news portal. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passing (public articles/filters/ticker/detail/ad-packages/ad-inquiry, auth login/me/protected, admin aggregate/pending/rewrite/watermark/publish/reject). Frontend: Home loads with hero+ticker+15 article cards, theme toggle switches to dark mode, article detail navigates OK, NCR page (5 cards), Disclaimer with jurisdiction text, State/UP with 6 district tabs, Advertise page with 5 packages and successful Hindi inquiry submission. Admin: login→dashboard→stats (58 pending, 14 published, 2 rejected, 1 ad-inquiry)→aggregate loads queue→select article→AI Rewrite converts English title/body to Hindi with 'AI' badge. Publish/reject verified via pytest.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 609 lines — acceptable but approaching threshold; consider splitting into routers/ (public, admin, auth) as it grows.
Publish/Reject endpoints return only {message, id}; consider returning the updated article for consistency with rewrite/watermark responses (better for frontend optimistic UI).
Aggregate endpoint runs synchronously and can take 15-30s from RSS network calls — consider background task or streaming progress.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Not implemented.
JWT in localStorage (gt_token) — susceptible to XSS; httpOnly cookies not used (playbook prefers httpOnly cookies).
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with credentials would be invalid; app currently does not send credentials so it works, but should be explicit origins if cookies are added later.
seed_data_creation: Aggregate created 58 pending RSS articles during testing; test also created a TEST_User ad-inquiry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary flows work end-to-end. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be re-run. Two cosmetic issues remain (hydration warning + no tooltip on disabled watermark). Auth playbook items (httpOnly cookies, brute-force lockout) are not implemented — flagged as code review comments, not blocking for this MVP.
